units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 3:4:2">Y. Nidd. III, 50ᵈ</cite> <he>אין סנדל אלא שרְצָמוֹ חי</he> a sandal fœtus (v. <cite ref="O01178"><he>סַנְדָּל</he></cite>) occurs only when a live fœtus has been pressing on it.
Nidd. 25ᵇ מתחלתו ולד הוא אלא שנ׳ Ar. (ed. שנרצף) the sandal was originally a normal embryo, but was flattened by pressure, v. supra.

<cite ref="Beitzah 28b:5">Bets. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>שפוד שנ׳</he> a roasting spit which has been crushed (and its point broken off), contrad. to <he>שנרצף</he>, v. <cite ref="T00995"><he>רָצַף</he></cite>.
